propositions: Plan reviews currently lack a criterion to assess whether a proposed change is actually needed, contributing to FixedBench's 35-65% over-action rate (adding mechanisms without establishing necessity).
Bug tickets bypass substantive plan review via an exempt-PASS short-circuit in workflow_ops.plan_review_precheck, receiving no DET or LLM evaluation regardless of merit.
A new pass-1 advisory criterion 'necessity' must flag plans that do not demonstrate why a change is needed, accepting well-motivated outcomes with reproduction and motivation.
The bug review tier must run a lightweight advisory-only stack (DET floor + necessity probe) for bug tickets instead of bare exemption, never blocking a bug verdict.

The necessity probe and bug tier must integrate via the existing R1/R3 advisory-criterion pattern (routing entry, CANONICAL_LLM registration, rubric, fixture validation) and auto-monitor effectiveness via the standing recorder.
